name: Kainan's Reapers
inspire: After an enemy fighter is slain, gain a number of bone-tithe tokens equal to their Bounty characteristic. After your Action step, you can pick a friendly fighter and remove a number of bone-tithe tokens equal to their Bounty characteristic. Then, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Mortek Advance
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step if a friendly Kainan or Khenta used a Core ability in that Action step.
reactions.flavorText: At a gesture, the Ossiarchs march forward in lockstep.
reactions.rulesText: Each friendly minion ({icon:minion}) can Move, but each must end that Move adjacent to 1 or more friendly minions ({icon:minion}).

abilities.name: Dire Ultimatum
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: A demand that cannot be denied.
abilities.rulesText: Friendly fighters cannot be picked to be the target of an Attack in the next Action step unless they are your leader ({icon:leader}). You can only use this ability once per game. This ability cannot be used if Mir Kainan is slain.

abilities.name: Ranks Unbroken By Dissent
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you pick a weapon as part of a melee Attack.
abilities.flavorText: Each nadirite blade of the Mortek Guard is but one facet of a terrifyingly efficient engine of war.
abilities.rulesText: If the target is Flanked and/or Surrounded, that weapon has Grievous ({icon:grievous}) for that Attack. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Monolith Stance
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: The Mortek Guard go on the defensive, weathering the blows of the enemy with cold disdain.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a number of friendly minions ({icon:minion}) equal to or less than the battle round number. Give each of those fighters a Guard token. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Assault
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: The Ossiarch Bonereapers do not rest until the tithe has been harvested.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly minion ({icon:minion}) with any Move and/or Charge tokens. Remove that fighter's Move and/or Charge tokens. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Six Ossiarch Bonereapers built around a sturdy six-health Kainan leading five fragile two-health Mortek, all slow at Move 2. Inspiring is an economy: slaying enemies earns bone-tithe tokens equal to their Bounty, which are spent to Inspire chosen fighters. When Kainan or Khenta acts, Mortek Advance moves the minions in lockstep, keeping them in tight blocks that flank and surround foes. The warband wins by grinding forward as a disciplined phalanx, using once-per-game shields of Guard and protection to trade efficiently.
